Setting.Name: Redmine::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enable OTRS → Redmine bridge.

Setting.Name: Redmine::BaseURL
Setting.Description: Redmine base URL without trailing slash (https://…).

Setting.Name: Redmine::OTRSBaseURL
Setting.Description: Public ticket-system base for links written into Redmine (no trailing slash), e.g. https://otrs.example.org/otrs or https://znuny.example.org/znuny. Empty = HttpType+FQDN+ScriptAlias.

Setting.Name: Redmine::APIKey
Setting.Description: Redmine REST API key (service account).

Setting.Name: Redmine::ProjectID
Setting.Description: Default Redmine project_id (pre-selected in form).

Setting.Name: Redmine::AllowedProjectIDs
Setting.Description: Comma/space/newline separated project IDs allowed for Create. Link/relink accepts any project. Empty = only Redmine::ProjectID.

Setting.Name: Redmine::TrackerID
Setting.Description: Default Redmine tracker_id (pre-selected in form).

Setting.Name: Redmine::PriorityID
Setting.Description: Optional Redmine priority_id.

Setting.Name: Redmine::DefaultDueDateDays
Setting.Description: Days from today for due_date on create (0 = today). Required by some trackers (e.g. Инцидент).

Setting.Name: Redmine::DefaultCustomFields
Setting.Description: Default Redmine custom fields on create, one per line: id=value (all trackers) or trackerId:id=value. CF 84 (Массовый инцидент) is applied automatically only for Incident tracker.

Setting.Name: Redmine::IncidentTrackerID
Setting.Description: Redmine tracker_id for «Инцидент». Escalation form requires mass-incident Yes/No.

Setting.Name: Redmine::SubjectPrefix
Setting.Description: Optional subject prefix. Leave empty in production.

Setting.Name: Redmine::Timeout
Setting.Description: HTTP timeout for Daemon/batch calls (seconds).

Setting.Name: Redmine::UITimeout
Setting.Description: HTTP timeout for agent popup / Admin interactive calls (seconds). Keep low to avoid pinning Apache workers.

Setting.Name: Redmine::SSLVersion
Setting.Description: Perl SSL strategy: auto (TLS 1.2+), or explicit IO::Socket::SSL SSL_version e.g. TLSv1_2.

Setting.Name: Redmine::AllowLegacyTLS
Setting.Description: Allow TLS strategies weaker than TLS 1.2 (not recommended).

Setting.Name: Redmine::CatalogCacheTTL
Setting.Description: Cache TTL (seconds) for Redmine projects/trackers used by the escalate form.

Setting.Name: Redmine::FormLoadAllProjects
Setting.Description: If enabled, escalate popup loads the full Redmine project list (slower). If disabled, only the default project and its trackers are loaded (fast).

Setting.Name: Redmine::SyncComments
Setting.Description: Sync OTRS articles to Redmine notes and import Redmine journals.

Setting.Name: Redmine::SyncAttachments
Setting.Description: Sync attachments both ways (size-limited).

Setting.Name: Redmine::InboundSync
Setting.Description: Enable cron polling Redmine → OTRS (status/comments/attachments).

Setting.Name: Redmine::NotifyOnStatusNote
Setting.Description: When StatusSync writes an inbound OTRS note (|note), notify the ticket owner and responsible (ForceNotificationToUserID).

Setting.Name: Redmine::AutoRetry
Setting.Description: Auto-retry failed escalations (status error, empty RedmineID). Default off until retry payload is verified.

Setting.Name: Redmine::MaxAttachmentBytes
Setting.Description: Max attachment size to sync (bytes).

Setting.Name: Redmine::SyncBatchLimit
Setting.Description: Max tickets per inbound sync cron run.

Setting.Name: Redmine::RetryBatchLimit
Setting.Description: Max tickets per auto-retry cron run.

Setting.Name: Redmine::AgentGroup
Setting.Description: Optional OTRS group name required to use escalate/link. Empty = any agent with ticket permission.

Setting.Name: Redmine::StatusSync
Setting.Description: Per Redmine status: set OTRS state and/or write a note. Value = OTRS state name, optionally with |note (e.g. open|note). |note also imports the Redmine comment from that status-change journal; comments without such a status transition are not copied.
